_what: Posts (pieces-screen.tsx): the pieces each pursuit is making, read from that pursuit's own database. A pursuit's database is any connection the vault names with `database_suffix` (secrets:names at the account's door), so a new pursuit shows here with no change; one whose database has no `table` shows nothing. `columns` are read by `tool`; `order` is the stages in the order a piece is shown (a stage not named comes after them). `ask_first` stages are the ones waiting on the person. A piece's slides are its `script` when that is a list of slides ([{head, body}]) or pages ({pages: [{sections: [{h, b}]}]}); its pictures are the files `extra.files` names, read through the files owner; a file kept only as a path on one computer cannot be read here and says so. `decisions.sources` are the rows of any table that wait on the person's yes (an email draft, a post): each names the `database_suffix` of the connections it reads (every database the vault names with that suffix that has the `table` is read, as pursuits are; one without it shows nothing), its `table`, its `id` and `title` columns, its `status` column, the `decided_at` column stamped on a decision, the `order` its rows are shown in, the `waiting` status they wait in, the `yes` and `skip` statuses Approve and Skip set (with their button words) and the `shows` fields drawn for each row, in order (`as: list` reads a JSON array as its items). A decision changes a row only while it still waits (decideStatement in decisions.ts).
